description: Search the library of facts. Each line leads with the sentence label: PROVEN covers the exact statement a machine checked, REASONED a real-world claim whose arithmetic a machine checked, and every match says what is not proven. Compact by default (claim start, label, receipt link); set detail true for the full wording.

detail.description: Full claim, what checked it and what is not proven

query.description: Words about the fact, e.g. "root theorem"

name: lookup_fact
title: Look up a proven fact
